div.head: VI Atr 8.1
div.ab: ⁊ þæt man heonan forð læte manna gehwylcne, ge earmne ge eadigne, folcrihtes wyrðe,
⁊ þæt man heonan forð læte manna gehwylcne, ge earmne ge eadigne, folcrihtes wyrðe;
And þæt man heonan forð læte manna gehwylcne, ge earmne ge eadigne, folcrihtes wyrðe.
und dass man hinfort jeden Menschen, so armen wie reichen, Landrechtes theilhaftig sein lasse,
and that henceforth every person, poor as well as rich, be allowed to share in folk-right,
and that henceforth all men, both rich and poor, shall be allowed the benefit of the law;
And that henceforth all people, rich and poor, shall be granted their legal rights.

note.seg: Wiederholt II Cn 1, 1.—Der Paraphrast denkt unter ius civile nicht etwa an Römisches Recht, obwohl der Name allerdings darauf zurückgeht
Repeated II Cn 1, 1.—By ius civile the paraphrast is not, say, thinking of Roman law, although the term does indeed derive from it
Cf. III Edg. 1, 1; VII Atr. 6, 1; II Cn. 1, 1.
